claims.statement: ASEAN ticket-based fuel reserve would offer the Philippines emergency rights to buy inventory held in Indonesia and Thailand, possibly from 2027; no letters or operational stocks are verified as of 12 November.

On 10 November Orlen issued termination notice for one QatarEnergy long-term LNG SPA after delivery force majeure, with a 60-day continuation. This is historical legal change, not a new 12 November LNG delivery.
US waivers for Russian diesel have not produced a confirmed sale and discharge from a tanker holding off the US East Coast; financing and legal/buyer obstacles persist in the November 11 report.

AP reports alumina flows from Irish Aughinish to Russian smelters while military end-use remains contested; an activist shipment figure is not an independently audited value and no EU export ban has been enacted today.
CNOOC said its Bohai deep-gas test well flowed around 800,000 cubic metres per day during testing, not confirmed commercial operations or replacement gas supply.
